ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 1:95; the visible ventral surface is dominated by low-intensity pixels with minimal high-intensity variance.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Uniformly dark pigment distribution with no distinct high-contrast geometric blobs or mottling visible on the ventral surface.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped central depression with a pixel-measured angle of approximately 55 degrees and a defined bounding-box depth.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular serration pattern with 7-9 visible peaks on the right lobe trailing edge and 5-6 visible on the left, separated from the water background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex trajectory following a broad upward sweep from the median notch to the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Two high-contrast, roughly circular pixel clusters indicative of barnacle colonies located at the far distal tips of both the left and right fluke lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle encrustations on both the left and right tips, characterized by irregular, high-intensity textured pixel groupings.
